selection: A8.1 found a predeclared positive scored RPE versus negative first-null RPE at this previously established harmful 73-ms first-crossing update. No other checkpoint is probed in A8.2.
candidate_raw_delta: For each of the same 480 selected slots: existing eta 0.2 times eligibility_at(slot, first_DOWN_time_us) times diagnostic_first_action_rpe. Use first-action eligibility snapshot before any later action, then independently clip w_pre_scored + fraction * raw_delta to the existing [0,2] mV bounds.
state_contract: All branches start from the exact saved A5 seed-2002 outcome-373 pre-scored-dopamine state. Diagnostic candidate branches differ only in selected effective weights. The first-action eligibility is obtained from exact replay of the unchanged historical trajectory, with weights at first DOWN verified equal to pre-scored-update weights.
probe: Identical disjoint 32-note A5 panel, plasticity and exploration off, preserving all cloned nonweight state. Existing no/full probes must reproduce byte-for-byte as JSON objects.
primary_endpoint: First upward 20-ms motor-window on-threshold crossing and first DOWN time relative to no update. A missing crossing or DOWN is silence and cannot support useful delay.

interpretation_locked_before_probe.useful_small_direction: The fixed 5% candidate step moves first crossing at least one 1-ms tick later than no update without silence.
interpretation_locked_before_probe.magnitude_problem: The small candidate has useful direction but the full candidate loses that direction, causes worse timing or silence.
interpretation_locked_before_probe.direction_not_supported: The small candidate advances crossing or is silent.
interpretation_locked_before_probe.inconclusive: The small candidate changes no first-crossing tick, or replay/state/reference checks fail.

prohibitions: no continuing training from the hybrid state
no claim beyond this one checkpoint
stop: Save exact raw branches and independent audit, report result, and stop before any development cohort.
